mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and additive CNS effects; donepezil (cholinesterase inhibitor) may antagonize perphenazine's antipsychotic effects while perphenazine's anticholinergic activity opposes donepezil's cholinergic mechanism.
action: Monitor closely for reduced efficacy of donepezil and increased anticholinergic side effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with minimal anticholinergic properties if possible.
